# Welcome {.unnumbered}

<div style="text-align: justify">
Welcome to the Graphical Modeling and Causal Inference (GMCI) website. Our goal is to provide a place for FAIR (= Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) GMCI research and analyses. For this, we moderate [GMCI Zenodo community](https://zenodo.org/communities/mardigmci/records?q=&l=list&p=1&s=10) where curated topical datasets as well as analysis repositories are stored. The [GMCI analysis library](chapters/notebooks.qmd) is hosted on this website. It features exemplary statistical notebooks that showcase advances in methodology and presents new applications.
</div>
We encourage and solicit submissions of datasets and notebooks by researchers from the broader academic community.
